page.title: Import
page.lead: Bring in data from Excel, CSV or PDF. Nothing is written until you approve it: every file becomes a proposal with a per-field diff.

new.title: New import
new.unsupported: This file type is not supported. Save it as .xlsx or .csv.

review.pending: {count, plural, one {# field needs a decision} other {# fields need a decision}}
review.violations: {count, plural, one {# consistency rule is not met} other {# consistency rules are not met}}
review.unverified: not confirmed by the page text

issues.misaligned: This value does not line up with the rest of the variant's column in the PDF. Check whether it belongs to a neighbouring column.
issues.sharedDisagrees: The source rows give different values for an attribute shared by the whole model.
issues.levelUnsupported: This attribute lives on a sub-model: import does not write an intermediate level yet.
issues.modelCodeMissing: The source gives no model code. Fill it in to apply this proposal.
issues.skuUnknown: No live item has the code “{code}”.
issues.priceIncomplete: A new price line needs a price and a unit.
